boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named destinations along the South Third Street and Cardinal Boulevard edge of Belknap Campus, each with a source-backed reason to stop.

cards.title: Cardinal Towne
cards.subtitle: South Third Street corridor, 1830 S. 3rd St.
cards.notes: Use this mixed-use complex as a clear landmark when exploring the South Third Street edge; its lower level adjoins restaurants and cafes.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL lists Cardinal Towne at 1830 S. 3rd St. and describes it as a mixed-use residential and commercial complex with restaurants and other businesses.
cards.access_notes: Residential areas may have limited key access; use public commercial entrances as appropriate.

cards.title: The Comfy Cow
cards.subtitle: South Third Street corridor, at Cardinal Towne
cards.notes: Look for this named ice-cream destination in the Cardinal Towne cluster when you want a dessert-focused stop beside the corridor.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed ice-cream stop beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL's Belknap Campus master-plan map lists The Comfy Cow in the Cardinal Towne campus-edge cluster.
cards.source_title: University of Louisville Campus Master Plan Executive Summary
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service and ordering details with the business before visiting.

cards.evidence_claim: UofL's Belknap Campus master-plan map lists Home Run Burgers & Fries in the Cardinal Towne campus-edge cluster.
cards.source_title: University of Louisville Campus Master Plan Executive Summary

cards.title: Speed Art Museum
cards.subtitle: South Third Street corridor, 2035 S. 3rd St.
cards.notes: Plan a museum visit or an Art Park walk at this South Third Street destination; the museum publishes its current hours and visitor guidance.
cards.short_summary: A major visual-art destination directly on South Third Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Speed Art Museum lists its location as 2035 S. 3rd Street on UofL's main Belknap Campus and states that its Art Park is open daily from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Speed Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are Wednesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday noon–5 p.m.; the Art Park is daily dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: South Fourth Street corridor, 2030 S. 4th St.
cards.notes: Use this west-edge campus destination for recreation; its official visitor information identifies courts, fitness studios, turf, and reservation options.
cards.short_summary: A large recreation facility just off the South Third Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL identifies the Student Recreation Center at 2030 S. 4th Street and lists fitness studios, basketball courts, strength-training areas, a turf field, and other facilities.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Visit Us | University of Louisville
cards.access_notes: Facility use requires a current membership; check the recreation site for current hours and reservation requirements.
